evidence.claim: A 2026 academic field study detailing near-surface seismology processing explicitly notes that real 2D seismic datasets acquired by GISIS in the Resende Basin were processed using the ECHOS software rather than by AspenTech acting as a processing service provider.

Documentation for the company's "Seismic Data Processing with Aspen Echos" educational curriculum emphasizes training oil and gas clients' in-house geoscientists to perform their own seismic data processing workflows.

Project Track Record.assessed_on: We could find zero evidence of AspenTech executing commercial, client-facing marine seismic data processing services on third-party offshore datasets, as the company operates strictly as an industrial software licensing vendor.

evidence.claim: AspenTech markets its Subsurface Science & Engineering (SSE) suite, including Aspen Echos seismic processing and Aspen GeoDepth velocity modeling applications, strictly as commercially available software engineered to parallelize and execute workloads optimized for client-owned or leased multi-core CPU/GPU high-performance computing clusters.

S-Cube maintains its own research-driven team of specialized geophysicists and developers to deploy its proprietary Time-Space Lag Adaptive Waveform Inversion (TSL-AWI) algorithms, but it positions these offerings as specialized software and algorithmic partnerships rather than as a multi-client marine data processing services center running standard production-scale external workloads.

Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed A dedicated, in-house processing service infrastructure or production geophysicist service teams executing external offshore contracts.

evidence.claim: Aspen Technology's official webinars highlight software capabilities such as Aspen Echos, which are marketed to reduce processing turnaround times for internal client teams through AI-driven automation and parallel processing architectures.

Public project records, such as joint presentations with Petrobras, focus exclusively on algorithm optimization and software deployment rather than vendor-executed service delivery milestones or proprietary commercial turnaround metrics.

Turnaround Time.assessed_on: It was not possible to verify demonstrated turnaround speeds against committed milestones for benchmark project sizes because Aspen Technology operates exclusively as a standalone industrial software vendor and does not provide commercial marine seismic data processing services on client data, resulting in a minimal score.

evidence.claim: The Subsurface Science & Engineering (SSE) suite solutions of Aspen Technology, Inc. (such as Aspen Echos and Aspen GeoDepth) are provided strictly via software commercial licensing rather than proprietary execution services.

Third-party entities and operators utilize AspenTech software for workflows like broadband reprocessing in the Krishna Godavari (KG) basin offshore India; these processing deliverables are executed by the purchasing clients or external service companies rather than AspenTech itself.
